checks.message: Native dbDelta installs/verifies the support schema
Real table contains delivery and application-type columns
Failed atomic prefix-index replacement preserves the prior key and schema marker
Native migration replaces prefix uniqueness with complete values before marking schema 5
Failed real ALTER TABLE leaves schema version pending
Retry removes the old unique key after verifying its replacement
Programme handler persists through native options and reads back correctly
Unchanged native option save is accepted
Real programme-option SQL failure preserves saved values
Public submission persists applicant and both delivery states in MariaDB
Real public handler rejects an exact duplicate email
Native nonce-protected approval persists its status and confirmation delivery
Repeated native approval does not create another confirmation delivery
Real WordPress rejects an invalid approval nonce without a new email
Unicode fields below character limits are stored losslessly
Character limits truncate overlong Unicode safely at complete characters
Array-valued public email is rejected without a PHP type error or insertion
Valid-format email beyond the database field limit is rejected before insertion
Long-address boundary examples are valid and share the first 90 characters
Distinct valid emails sharing a 90-character prefix can both register
Applicant deletion removes its actual MariaDB row
Deletion removes support personal payloads from the actual audit table
Numeric ID collisions preserve real event payload and capacity history
Ambiguous historical logs block deletion without removing unrelated data
Real applicant-delete SQL failure preserves access to remaining records
Real programme deletion retains legacy interests and the future pool
Real WordPress renderer keeps legacy-interest details accessible after cohort deletion
Interest-list preview truncates emoji at complete characters
Strict ledger read distinguishes a genuinely absent database row
Strict ledger read returns persisted operational history
Actual ledger SELECT failure returns a safe error rather than an absent reservation
Noncritical legacy ledger wrapper preserves its array contract on database failure
Corrupted operational details fail closed rather than becoming an empty history
Native option lock establishes token ownership
Native unique option key rejects another live owner
Wrong-token release cannot remove a native lock
Expired native lock is reclaimed without allowing stale-owner deletion
Atomic SQL compare-delete preserves a replacement from a second database connection
Native owner release removes its temporary lock
Log-only support workflow never attempts outbound mail

limitations: JetEngine/JetFormBuilder are not installed or exercised by this support fixture.
Outbound mail is intercepted and normal sends use Log only mode.
